# Ship AI

> Ship AI is a community of AI craftspeople in Phoenix and Tempe, Arizona. Technical founders and builders who show their work — the build, the workflow, the decisions behind it. Demos over memos: no slideware, no hard selling. If it ships, it speaks.

Ship AI runs recurring in-person workshops and builder presentations. Every session follows the same three-part format: an AI News Briefing (first 20 minutes, a tight rundown of what matters for builders), the main session — a workshop or a presentation with a live build — and 5-Minute Demos (members show what they shipped and what they learned building it).

The current program is Zero to Launch: six free go-to-market sessions on alternating Wednesdays from August 5 to October 14, 2026, building to a hackathon on October 16-18, 2026 where participants launch what they have built. Sessions alternate between Workuity Biltmore (2390 E Camelback Rd Ste 130, Phoenix AZ 85016) and CEI Gateway (275 N Gateway Dr, Phoenix AZ 85034). Free, in person, and open to anyone; the hackathon has no attendance requirement and no application.

Every session publishes its full kit for free, with no account or signup: the slide deck (viewable in the browser at /hackathon/workshops/<slug>/deck), a short follow-along guide (/hackathon/workshops/<slug>/guide, also downloadable as markdown), and the session's skill files as a zip. Skill files are plain markdown with YAML frontmatter that run in Claude Code, the Codex extension, or any agent that reads a skills directory; they unzip into .claude/skills/ and cover funnel mapping, channel plans, analytics instrumentation, B2B ICP and outbound, positioning and pitch, marketing site structure and copy, content and programmatic pages, social profiles, content automation, paid marketing, unit economics and pricing.

Topics and demo requests are submitted and voted on by members, and shape every session. The community values craft over hype, taste (opinions about design, architecture, and curated experiences), and living on the bleeding edge — pushing each model past what it's supposed to be capable of.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.shipai.club/): what Ship AI is, upcoming events pulled live from Meetup
- [Zero to Launch hackathon](https://www.shipai.club/hackathon): the October 16-18 hackathon, rules, prize categories and sponsorship
- [The workshops](https://www.shipai.club/hackathon/workshops): all six sessions, dates, venues and what each covers
- [Zero to Launch skills](https://www.shipai.club/hackathon/skills): 27 free go-to-market skill files (agent-runnable markdown), downloadable as a zip per session or all at once
- [AI meetup in Phoenix](https://www.shipai.club/ai-meetup-phoenix): Phoenix events, venue, and format
- [AI meetup in Tempe](https://www.shipai.club/ai-meetup-tempe): Tempe events, venue, and format
